# Programs 1 summer program across 7 teams: Merchandising, Marketing, Technology, People/ESG, Digital Operations, Finance and Legal


*Last updated: November 2026*


No Saks Fifth Avenue internship is open as of November 2026. Saks runs a 9-week paid Summer Internship Program for college juniors, per[its program page](https://careers.exemplarluxurygroup.com/us/en/summer-internship-program) , and the last cohort we can confirm is summer 2025, when[Saks Global said on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/saks-com_this-summer-we-welcomed-10-interns-to-saks-activity-7357095070036029441-5FHI) it had welcomed 10 interns. Saks didn't publish when that cycle opened or closed, and its own pages and posts show no summer 2026 cohort. No summer 2027 date has been announced. The only dated signal is an info session Saks held on November 13, 2023 for summer 2024 internships, so recruiting may start as early as late fall. In plain words: if the program runs again, you apply during the 2026 to 2027 school year and intern in summer 2027.


---


## What Is a Saks Fifth Avenue Internship?


A Saks Fifth Avenue internship is a 9-week paid summer program for college juniors at the luxury department store, with placements on the Merchandising, Marketing, Technology, People/ESG, Digital Operations, Finance and Legal teams, per[Saks's program page](https://careers.exemplarluxurygroup.com/us/en/summer-internship-program) . Interns meet senior leaders, mix on-the-job work with classroom sessions, and finish with interviews with members of the business. Saks Fifth Avenue's parent, Saks Global, filed for Chapter 11 in January 2026 and emerged on June 26, 2026 renamed Exemplar Luxury Group,[per Quartz](https://finance.yahoo.com/small-business/articles/saks-global-exits-bankruptcy-renamed-131232305.html) . Saks doesn't publish a conversion rate.


## When Do Saks Fifth Avenue Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


Saks doesn't publish its internship dates, and we couldn't find a dated posting for the summer 2025 or summer 2026 cycle on its own board or in archived copies of it. So we can't say when the last window opened or closed, and we won't guess one for summer 2027. Two first-party signals help. On November 13, 2023, Saks invited rising seniors to a virtual info session for its 2024 Summer Internship, about seven months before a June start. And on August 1, 2025, Saks Global posted that it had welcomed 10 interns that summer. Nothing on Saks's own pages or posts shows a summer 2026 cohort, and the company has since come through a Chapter 11 restructuring, so whether summer 2027 runs is unconfirmed.


Now · November 2026 YOU ARE HERE


Nothing is open. The Exemplar Luxury Group board listed 744 openings on November 13, 2026, and none was a student internship. Use the gap to build proof you can point to if postings go up.


Two remote Externships that fit:[Beats by Dre Creative Advertising Strategy](https://www.extern.com/externships/beats-by-dre-creative-advertising-strategy-externship-nov-2026) for marketing, or[BeReal Product Management](https://www.extern.com/externships/bereal-product-management-externship-nov-2026-2) for digital and product work.


November to December 2026


Prepare. Set a job alert on the careers site, follow Saks and Exemplar Luxury Group on LinkedIn for info sessions, and update your resume. In 2023, Saks's info session for summer 2024 came in mid-November.


Winter to spring 2027 (no date announced)


Watch the board. If summer 2027 internships are posted, they'll appear on the shared Exemplar Luxury Group board. Search "intern" and apply to the team that fits you.


After you apply


Saks doesn't publish its interview steps or timing for interns. Expect to hear from the team you applied to.


Summer 2027 EXPECTED


If the program runs: 9 weeks, with team work, classroom sessions and meetings with senior leaders, ending with interviews with members of the business.


*How to read this page: our dates come from tracking previous recruiting cycles and daily posting data. Treat them as informed estimates based on historical patterns, not confirmed dates. The company's official careers page is always the most current source. If a role is posted there, go by that, even if this page suggests the window hasn't opened yet.*


### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


Saks doesn't say whether it reviews intern applications on a rolling basis or sets a deadline, and it didn't publish the last cycle's dates. What we do know is that the program is small: Saks Global said it welcomed 10 interns in summer 2025, across the whole group. With so few spots and no announced window, the safe move is to have your alert set and your resume ready before anything posts, then apply in the first days a role appears.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


Saks publishes only one eligibility rule for its internship. What we can say:


• **Class year:** college juniors, per the program page. Saks's 2023 info session was aimed at rising seniors, which is the same group by the summer.


• **GPA:** not published.


• **Work authorization and sponsorship:** not published.


• **Availability:** 9 weeks in summer. Saks doesn't publish a location.


• **Who can apply:** outside students; the program page links to the public job board.


### Do You Need Retail Experience?


Saks doesn't say. Its program page says the curriculum covers "basic retail language, interviewing skills and time management", which suggests it doesn't expect you to arrive knowing retail. Interest in luxury retail and a clear reason for the team you pick will matter more than a store job.

## What Is the Saks Fifth Avenue Application and Interview Process Like?


Saks doesn't publish its interview steps. This is what its own pages and posts show.


1. **Watch for info sessions.** In November 2023 Saks ran a virtual info session for its summer 2024 internships on LinkedIn.


2. **Find the posting.** The program page's "Search for Opportunities" link goes to the shared Exemplar Luxury Group board.


3. **Apply to one team.** Pick the team that matches your coursework and say why in your application.


4. **Interview.** Rounds, format and timing aren't published.


Saks publishes no acceptance rate. The only cohort size on record is 10 interns in summer 2025, across Saks Global.

## How Do You Stand Out for a Saks Fifth Avenue Internship?


First, be early: the 2025 cohort was 10 interns across Saks Global, so a few days' delay can matter. Second, pick a team and show you fit it, with a campaign you ran, a data project or a finance model you built. Third, know the business: Saks Fifth Avenue now sits in Exemplar Luxury Group with Neiman Marcus and Bergdorf Goodman, and the 2025 interns visited the Saks Fifth Avenue and Bergdorf Goodman flagships. Saks doesn't publish an applicant count or conversion rate.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 Saks Fifth Avenue internship?


No. No Saks Fifth Avenue internship is open as of November 2026, and Saks's own pages and posts show no summer 2026 cohort. The last confirmed cohort was summer 2025; its open and close dates weren't published. No summer 2027 date is announced, so set a job alert and check the board through spring 2027.


### When do Saks Fifth Avenue internship applications open?


Saks doesn't publish a date, and we couldn't find the open date for the 2025 or 2026 cycles. The only dated signal is a November 13, 2023 info session for summer 2024 internships, so recruiting has started in late fall before. Check the board from now through spring 2027.


### Is the Saks Fifth Avenue internship paid?


Yes. Saks's program page calls it "a 9-week paid program". It doesn't publish the rate, and we didn't find a Saks posting that states one, so we can't give a figure. Look for the pay on the summer 2027 posting if one goes up.


### Who is eligible for the Saks Fifth Avenue internship?


College juniors, according to Saks's program page, which means rising seniors by the summer. Saks's 2023 info session invited rising seniors too. Saks doesn't publish a GPA minimum, work authorization rules or sponsorship terms, so check those on the posting itself.


### Which teams hire Saks Fifth Avenue interns?


Seven, per the program page: Merchandising, Marketing, Technology, People/ESG, Digital Operations, Finance and Legal. Past intern titles quoted there include Talent Acquisition, Public Relations, Client Engagement, and Analytics Engineering & Data Insights. Saks hasn't said which teams will take interns in summer 2027, so check each posting if roles go up.


### Does the Saks Fifth Avenue internship lead to a full-time offer?


Saks doesn't publish a conversion rate. Its program page says that at the end of the program, all eligible interns showcase what they learned through a series of interviews with members of the business. It doesn't say how many interns receive offers, so treat a return offer as possible, not expected.
